name: v2-primitives
title: Fable UI v2 Primitives (Experimental)
description: Provider-free React layout, typography, metric, entity, chart, filter, and local-image components.

export { FableBarChart } from "./chart"

export { FableEntityCard } from "./entity-card"

export { FableFilterBar } from "./filter-bar"
export type { FableFilterBarProps, FableFilterOption } from "./filter-bar"
export { FableMediaImage } from "./media-image"
export type { FableMediaImageProps } from "./media-image"
export { FableMetricCard } from "./metric-card"
export type { FableMetricCardProps, FableMetricFormat } from "./metric-card"
export { FableRichText, FableTypography } from "./typography"
export type { FableRichTextProps, FableRichTextSpan, FableTextLevel, FableTypographyProps } from "./typography"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" export interface FableEntityCardProps { name: string location: string description: string valueLabel?: string value: number unit?: string locale?: string changePercent?: number className?: string } export function FableEntityCard({ name, location, description, valueLabel = "Value", value, unit, locale, changePercent, className, }: FableEntityCardProps) { const initials = name .split(/\s+/) .filter(Boolean) .slice(0, 2) .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase()) .join("") return (
{initials || "—"}

{name}

{location}

{description}

{valueLabel}

{new Intl.NumberFormat(locale || "en", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(value)} {unit ? {unit} : null}

{changePercent !== undefined ? (

= 0 ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300" : "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive" )} aria-label={`${changePercent >= 0 ? "Up" : "Down"} ${Math.abs(changePercent)} percent`} > {changePercent > 0 ? "+" : ""} {changePercent}%

) : null}
